# U124: The leader on Home: Amara’s Watching spans thirteen teams, so it is a table of teams, worst first, with no person’s name in it; a team’s “{k} need attention” opens Goals whose count line says k; “Changed since Friday 6 Nov” counts open lists of that length, and the table’s last column is “Since Fri 6 Nov”; on Wed 11 Nov one cell says how many of them are checked in for week 46, and opens the rest

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `HOME-MANAGER`, `HOME-LEADER`, `HABIT-MEASURE`
- **Budget:** at most 3 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U124

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Home rule 4 (HM3): three or more teams are drawn as teams, ordered as Goals orders "By team" (worstGroupsFirst).
- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Check:** The watch"] in the you in the [data part="Goals (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`) shows.
- **Check:** The teams table (`.teams-table`) in the watch"] in the you in the [data part="Goals (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if Watching’s heading is “{head}”.
- _Note:_ Worst first: the most off track, then at risk, then no recent update, then no check-in yet; five teams, then the rest.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if the teams are not five, worst first: {JSON.stringify(tally)}.
- _Note:_ No person's name is in the table: teams and goals are ranked, never people.
- **Check:** It fails if the teams table names {named.join(', ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A team's "{k} need attention" opens Goals for that team with the switch on, and its count line says k.
- **Step.** Press the a in the teams needs (`.teams-needs a`) in the teams table (`.teams-table`) in the watch"] in the you in the [data part="Goals (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=watching&team=…&attention=1”.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if a team’s “{k} need attention” opened Goals saying “{line}”.
- _Note:_ Changed since (rule 5, HM4). Monday's first look counted from that Monday, and nothing had moved: the part is absent. Home last opened on Fri 6 Nov (the `home-seen` pref, per browser), on Wed 11 Nov it says what moved since, each count opening Goals with a count line of that length and the filter line in its words; the teams table's last column too.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Check:** The watch"] in the you in the [data part="Goals (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if “Changed since” shows on Monday though nothing moved since Monday.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The since"] in the [data part="Changed (`[data-part="Changed since"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if “Changed since” says “{title}”, counts {moved.map((m) => m.text).join(', ')}, with {rows} rows.
- **Check:** It fails if a “Changed since” row has no status shape beside its word.
- For each of `moved`:
  - **Step.** Press a part of the page in the since"] in the [data part="Changed (`[data-part="Changed since"]`).

  - **Check:** The Goals count line shows.

  - **Check:** It fails if “{m.text}” opened Goals whose filter line says “{words}”.
